answer: Each new agent must lock a 500-token bond before its answers count, and the bond unlocks only after ten epochs of peer-attested work. That waiting window is the horizon a cheater must cross: 100 fakes tie up 50,000 tokens for the whole stretch. Splitting funds across many wallets doesn't help, because every fake still needs its own full bond and its own reviewed answers, like hauling each timber beam up a mesa one trip at a time. An honest agent posts the bond once and gets it back in full.
